title: Breadth-First Search on Tree Quiz
description: A quick check to review BFS on trees.

questions.question: Which data structure is commonly used for BFS?
questions.explanation: BFS uses a queue to process nodes in First In, First Out order.

questions.question: For a tree with root A, left child B, and right child C, what is the BFS order?
questions.codeSnippet:
Tree:
    A
   / \
  B   C

BFS visits level by level.
questions.explanation: BFS visits the root first, then its children from left to right.
